articles.description: The 2026 Russian legislative election to select all 450 seats of the State Duma (the lower house of parliament) ended on 20 September with President Vladimir Putin’s United Russia party securing 57.83% of the vote. articles.title: High Freight Costs Push More U.S. LNG Toward Europe
articles.description: Europe is currently benefiting from the closed arbitrage between the U.S. Gulf Coast and Asia and is taking more LNG supplies in possible relief from concerns about winter gas supply. The Atlantic-Pacific arbitrage is closed for the rest of this year, due to high shipping costs, and this has led to a redirection of most U.S. spot cargoes toward Europe, where the freight costs are much lower. articles.title: Two-Month Trade Truce Extension Leaves Markets Cold After Trump-Xi Summit
articles.description: Donald Trump gave Xi Jinping the full state-visit treatment in Washington, but markets were more interested in what the two leaders did not deliver. After three days of ceremony, an unusually warm presidential welcome and repeated pledges to stabilize relations between the world's two largest economies, the main economic outcome was a two-month extension of the existing U.S.-China trade truce, pushing its expiration from November 10 to January 10, 2027. That averted an immediate return to escalation, but fell short of the longer runway many investors…

articles.title: Qatar Extends LNG Force Majeure as Hormuz Crisis Drags On
articles.description: State-owned QatarEnergy has extended the force majeure on LNG deliveries to Asia and Europe by another month through the end of November, as LNG cargo traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remains largely blocked amid the protracted U.S.-Iran stalemate over the chokepoint and pathways to end the war. articles.title: Indonesia's Coal Exports Sink 23% as Global Demand Heads for a Record
articles.description: The world’s biggest exporter of thermal coal, Indonesia, is not benefiting from tightening global coal markets amid an Asian switch to coal from gas due to the Middle East crisis choking LNG supply. articles.title: European Gas Prices Rally on U.S.-Iran Stalemate
articles.description: Europe’s benchmark natural gas prices rose by 2% in early trade in Amsterdam on Monday, as the United States and Iran are again locked in a stalemate over negotiations and conditions for reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.
